mainEntity.name: Is hosting.com the same as A2 Hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A2 Hosting announced on its own blog in April 2025 that it is now hosting.com.
HostingAdvice reported fast speeds and quick live chat replies. Renewal prices are among the highest it saw, so check them before you buy.
Starter is $1.49 a month, Pro $3.49 and Max $5.99 on 12-month plans. They renew at $13.99, $19.99 and $27.99 a month.
It lists an AI assistant called Orbi, an AI website builder for WordPress and an MCP server. We did not test them.

mainEntity.name: Does hosting.com have a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: It lists a 30-day money-back guarantee on its Black Friday page.

mainEntity.name: When does the hosting.com Black Friday offer end?

acceptedAnswer.text: The page we read says 14 December 2026. Check the page before you buy.
